grid.cell_intervals: half-open [edge_n,edge_n+1), with domain-max assigned to last cell

mapping.boundary_policy: clip only for exact/roundoff domain-edge coordinates; coordinates materially outside domain are ERROR

derived_features.porosity: raw porosity path; normalization policy determined from TRAIN variance only

physics_sidecar.M_face: D9R1/C7 conservative face metric; NOT predictor

normalization.zero_variance: constant channel; no divide by zero

prohibitions: NO interpolation unless future versioned contract
NO OOD label use for model selection
NO M_face predictor without new contract
